prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create a single square isolated material asset for the actual Ropers Archery mobile app, Ivory Scorebook visual direction.
Subject: a nearly square charcoal-gray layered foam archery butt, viewed exactly orthographically from the front. Clean straight edges, very shallow visible foam thickness along the lower edge, a soft restrained contact shadow. Centered on the foam is a perfectly flat, perfectly square, warm-white BLANK paper sheet, aligned straight, covering exactly 88 percent of the butt width and height. The paper's sides must be parallel to the image edges, with absolutely no perspective tilt, warp, curling or skew, because precise circular scoring rings will later be overlaid in software. Four tiny realistic dark paper pins, one near each corner, keep the sheet attached. No extra pins.
Material quality: subtle tactile paper fibers and fine matte foam grain, refined realistic sports-equipment materials. Gentle broad even studio lighting, enough light to keep the blank paper clearly warm white. Charcoal frame is neutral, not blue or brown. Quiet warmth appropriate to an ivory paper scorebook interface.
Composition: object occupies roughly 94 percent of the square canvas, complete object visible, equal outer margin, perfectly centered, no cropping. Front face is a true square. Transparent background around the entire object and its very subtle shadow.
Non-negotiable: paper is COMPLETELY BLANK. NO printed target rings, circles, scoring marks, crosshairs, arrows, shafts, holes, text, logos, labels, numbers, illustration, scenery, people, animals, table, ground or other objects. No decorative glow, no dramatic gradient, no visible perspective. This is a clean reusable raster material base asset, not a screen mockup.
Output: square high-quality transparent PNG appearance, around 1024 by 1024, with accurate clean alpha edges.
